title: A family of spectral conjugate gradient algorithms derived by least-squares approximations based on a modified quasi--Newton update with application to a revised robust binary classification model
abstract: arXiv:2609.13526v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We develop a spectral three-term modification of the classic Hestenes--Stiefel conjugate gradient algorithm, preserving its anti-jamming characteristic and, simultaneously, taking care of the sufficient descent property. We discuss how a modified secant equation can be extracted from our modification scheme, yielding a memoryless BFGS updating formula. Then, the spectral parameter of our method is obtained by steering its direction toward the given BFGS direction within a least-squares context. Using our technical improvements, we outline the general framework of our algorithm and discuss its theoretical features, including the descent and convergence properties, without the convexity assumption. We put our algorithm to the test in comparison with the three other conjugate gradient algorithms on a set of CUTEr unconstrained optimization test models, comparing the outputs using the Dolan--More measure. translated_title: 基于修正拟牛顿更新的最小二乘近似导出的谱共轭梯度算法族及其在改进的鲁棒二分类模型中的应用
translated_abstract: 我们开发了经典Hestenes-Stiefel共轭梯度算法的一种谱三项修正方法，在保持其抗干扰特性的同时，兼顾了充分下降性质。我们讨论了如何从该修正方案中提取出修正割线方程，从而得到无记忆的BFGS更新公式。随后，通过在最小二乘框架下将算法方向引导至给定的BFGS方向，获得了该方法的谱参数。利用这些技术改进，我们概述了算法的总体框架，并在不假设凸性的条件下讨论了其理论特性，包括下降性与收敛性。我们在一组CUTEr无约束优化测试模型上，将该算法与其他三种共轭梯度算法进行了对比测试，并使用Dolan-Moré度量方法比较了测试结果。接下来，我们提供了一个简明的评估...
tldr: 该论文提出了基于修正拟牛顿（BFGS）更新的最小二乘近似导出的谱三项共轭梯度算法族，在不假设凸性的条件下证明了其下降性与收敛性，并将其成功应用于改进的鲁棒二分类模型。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a family of spectral three-term conjugate gradient algorithms derived from least-squares approximations based on a modified quasi-Newton (BFGS) update, proving descent and convergence properties without convexity assumptions, with application to a revised robust binary classification model.
